profile.headline:
Experienced .NET Full Stack Developer - 
Formerly at CoreLogic and CoStar Group, now at Green Street !
profile.summary:
In 2005, I earned my CA real estate broker's license and tried to turn my real estate investing success into my own brokerage firm.  In 2008, I admitted defeat and returned to the computer software industry.

I found an opportunity as a Software Engineer for Marshall & Swift/Boeckh (MSB).  In 2014, MSB was purchased by CoreLogic.  As a Sr. Software Engineer, I worked on a number of CoreLogic's enterprise products, including RCT Express, SwiftEstimator7, MVP and IOM.  To each project, I brought intelligence, integrity, creativity, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for success.

From about 2015 until 2018, I was a team leader/manager as well as a technical contributor.  This "trial by fire" helped me to develop better interpersonal and communication skills.  This is something that I continue to work on today.

In 2018, CoreLogic closed the LA office and I accepted a transfer to Irvine.  This brought me to a new set of projects like FactCheck and AutomatIQ, as I returned to a contributing role.  I also worked with technologies that were new to me like .NET Core, GCP and KTA.

In 2021, I finally left CoreLogic after more than 12 years, for an opportunity with the CoStar Group.  (This was before CoreLogic was sold.)  At CoStar, I worked on sites associated with LoopNet.com, and was able to develop in React, NodeJS, C#.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework and SQL Server.  I also supported legacy .NET Framework applications, developed a new AWS-hosted project named MVS (Marketing Video Service), and created dashboards powered by Google Analytics and Google Big Query.

I was laid off from CoStar this past January, and am now looking for my next position, which I hope will be even better for me and my family.

Specialties:  React.js, C#.NET, MVC, .NET Core, REST, Entity Framework.
Skills:  Unit testing, jQuery, Web API, WPF, SQL, Jenkins.

It's all in the cloud here (AWS) so I'm learning that as well !

Skills: Software Development · Vue.js · Typescript - .NET 6/8 · mySQL · AWS - Python

positions.title: Owner/Broker
positions.description:
For 3 years I was an independent real estate broker, representing buyers in Orange County.  I thoroughly enjoyed this but my sales skills were not good enough to keep me afloat.  No regrets though!

While doing this I created a free self-service FSBO website, www.ICREQ.com.  This is no longer operational, but it got me started learning C#.NET.

positions.title: Web Developer (Java)
positions.description: We developed company intranet websites using server-side Java.  The data involved was primarily related to Human Resources.  We ran UNIX with iPlanet as our application server and developed our own exhaustive and proprietary Java architecture for creating dynamic web pages.  Also developed custom applications and implemented them for all our clients.
